उन्-√ मील् (उद्-√ मील्) P. -मीलति, to open the eyes; to open (as an eye), ṢaḍvBr.; Hariv.; R.; Hit.; Bhaṭṭ.; to become visible, come forth, appear, Bhartṛ.; Gīt.; Uttarar.; Prab. : Caus. -मीलयति, to cause to open, open, MBh.; BhP.; Mṛcch. &c.; to cause to appear, make visible, show, Prab.; Daś. Comm. on Lāṭy.
a: उन्मील् — {c1c} P. 1 To open (as the eyes); उदमीलीच्च लोचने Bk. 15. 102; 16. 8. --2 To be awakened or roused, be excited; उन्मिमील विशदं विषमेषुः Śi. 10. 72; Bk. 1. 33. --3 To expand, blow (as lotuses); सरोभिरुन्मीलितपद्मलोचनैः Ki. 4. 3; Māl. 1. 38, 9. 15. --4 To be diffused or spread, cluster round; प्रांतोन्मीलन्मनोहरकुंतलैः U. 1. 20; उन्मीलन्मधुगंध Gīt. 1. --5 To appear, become manifest; खं वायुर्ज्वलनो जलं क्षितिरिति त्रैलोक्यमुन्मीलति Prab. 1. 2. --6 To break forth, burst out; U. 4. --Caus. 1 To open (eyes, lotuses &c.); तदेतदुन्मीलय चक्षुरायतं V. 1. 5; Mk. 1. 33. --2 To display, show; त्वयाद्य साधुतोन्मीलिता.

m: उन्-मील m. becoming visible, appearance, Kauś.
a: उन्मीलः, --लनं — 1 Opening (of the eyes), awaking; ज्ञानांजनशलाकाभिर्नेत्रोन्मीलनकारकः Mb. --2 Unfolding, opening (in general); प्रियागुणसहस्राणामेकोन्मीलनपेशलः U. 6. 34. --3 Touching up, painting; आलेख्य˚ K. 267. --4 Expanding, blowing.

P. 1; awakened; Mv. 1. 48; K. 110. --3 Touched up, painted; उन्मीलितं तूलिकयेव चित्रं Ku. 1. 32. --तं (In Rhet.) An open reference (to anything).

drunk, intoxicated, furious, MaitrUp.; MBh.; Śak. &c.

Pterospermum Acerifolium, L.
N. of a Rakṣas, R.
of one of the eight forms of Bhairava.
a: उन्मत्त — p. p. 1 Drunk, intoxicated. --2 Insane, frantic, mad; द्वावत्रोन्मत्तौ V. 2; अहो उन्मत्तास्मि संवृत्ता U. 3, 5. 30; Ś. 6; Ms. 9. 79. --3 (a) Puffed, elevated. (b) Furious, wild; मदोन्मत्तस्य भूपस्य कुंजरस्य च गच्छतः Pt. 1. 161; U. 2; Śi. 6. 31. --4 Possessed by a ghost or an evil spirit; Y. 2. 32; Ms. 3. 161 ( वातपित्तश्लेष्मसंनिपातग्रहसंभवेनोपसृष्टः Mit.). --त्तः The thorn apple (धत्तूर); N. of another tree (मुचकुद). --Comp. --कीर्तिः, --वेशः N. of Śiva. --गंगं N. of a country (where the Gaṅgā roars furiously along). --दर्शन, --रूप a. maniac-like, mad in appearance. --प्रलपित a. spoken in drunkenness or madness. --(तं) the words of a madman. --लिंगिन् a. pretending to be mad.

[उद्-ऊर्ध्वं मुखं यस्य] 1 Raising the face, looking up; ˚दर्शन looking upwards; अद्रेः शृंगं हरति पवनः किंस्विदित्युन्मुखीभिः Me. 14, 100; R. 1. 39, 11. 26; आश्रम˚ 1. 53. --2 Ready, intent on, on the point of, about to, prepared for; तमरण्यसमाश्रयोन्मुखं R. 8. 12 about to retire to the woods; 16. 9, 3. 12; उदयोन्मुखचंद्रिका M. 5. 7; भेदोन्मुखं V. 2. 7; Ku. 6. 48. --3 Eager, waiting for, expecting, looking up to; तस्मिन् संयमिनामाद्ये जाते परिणयोन्मुखे Ku. 6. 34; लक्ष्मीरिव गुणोन्मुखी R. 12. 26, 6. 21, 11. 23. --4 Sounding, speaking or making a sound; परभृतोन्मुखी Ku. 6. 2 speaking through the cuckoo.

m: उन्-मुख—दर्शन n. looking at with upraised face or with eager expectation, Mudr.
उन्-मुखर (उद्-मु˚) mfn. loud sounding, noisy, Prab.
a: उन्मुखर — a. Loud-sounding, noisy.

m: उन्-मुख—ता f. the state of having the face raised
state of watching or expectancy, Kathās.

उन्-√ मुच् (उद्-√ मुच्) P. Ā. -मुञ्चति, -ते (Impv. 2. sg. -मुमुग्धि, RV. i, 25, 21; aor. 2. sg. -अमुक्षास्, AV. ii, 10, 6) to unbind, unfasten, RV. i, 25, 21; AV.; to unfasten one's self, get loose (only Ā.), AV. xiv, 1, 57; ii, 10, 6; ŚBr.; to pull off, take off (clothes &c.), AitBr.; PārGṛ.; Kathās. &c.; to unseal (a letter), Rājat.; to liberate, set free, R.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.; to send away, throw off; to sling; to give out, utter, Hariv.; Pañcat. : Caus. -मोचयति, to unbind, unfasten, set free, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
a: उन्मुच् — {c6c} U. 1 To unfasten, pull off; उन्मुच्य सूत्रेण विनैव हाराः R. 6. 28; take off (clothes &c.); आत्मकंठादुन्मुच्य K. 147, 67; Bk. 3. 22. --2 To loosen, liberate, free from (as a bond); ऋणमुन्मुच्य देवानां Mb.; open (as a letter); लेखमुन्मुच्य Rāj. T. 3. 235; K. 221. --3 To raise, elevate, send forth (as sound); आर्तनादो हि यः पौरैरुन्मुक्तः Rām. --4 To fling, hurl (as a missile). --Caus. 1 To extricate, loosen, free; Mv. 6. 46. --2 To deliver.

m: उन्-मुच m. N. of a Ṛṣi, MBh.
उन्-मुचु m. id., ib.
उन्-मुद् (उद्-√ मुद्).
उन्-मुदित mfn. exulting, rejoicing, BhP.

s: tri, (udgatA mudrA yasmAt .) praPullaH । vikasitaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: tri॰ udgatA mudrA yasmAt prA॰ ba॰ । 1 tyaktamudre, 2 vikasite ca
m: उन्-मुद्र mfn. (उद्-मु˚) unsealed
opened, blown (as a flower), L.
unbound, unrestrained, wild (through joy), Prasannar.
a: उन्मुद्र — a. [उद्गता मुद्रा यस्मात्] 1 Unsealed. --2 Opened, blown, expanded (as a flower).

m: उन्-मुग्ध See 1. उन्-मुह् below.
उन्-मुग्ध mfn. confounded, confused, Siddh.
silly, stupid, Kathās.
2. उन्-मुह् (क् or ट्, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 33) mfn. confounded, silly.
उन्-मुक्त mfn. taken off, laid aside, Kathās.
thrown out, uttered, R.
(ifc.) free from
deprived of, wanting, VarBṛS.
a: उन्मुक्त — p. p. Pulled off, loosened &c.; ˚कंठं bitterly.

m: उन्-मुक्ति f. deliverance, MaitrS.
उन्-मुक्षा f. id., ib.
उन्-√ मुर्छ् (उद्-√ मुर्छ्) P. -मूर्छति, to become weak, faint, Kuv.; Mcar.
उन्-मुष् (उद्-√ मुष्).
उन्-मुषित mfn. stolen, VarBṛS.

v: pu॰ unnatA nABiryasya ac samA॰ । sUryyavaMSye nfpaBede “unnABa ityudgatanAmaDeyaH” raGuH asaMjYAyAntu na ac । unnABirityeva tri॰ । unnatA nABiH prA॰ sa॰ । unnatanABO puMstrI॰ ।
m: उन्-नाभ m. N. of a king, Ragh.
a: उन्नाभ — a. Having a projecting navel, corpulent. --भः N. of a king of the Solar race.

v: pu॰ ud + nada--GaY । uccaSabde “SaraBonnAdasaMjuzwam nAnAmfganizevitam” BA॰ ba॰ 158 a॰ ।
m: उन्-नाद m. crying out, clamour, MBh.
N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa, BhP.
a: उन्नादः — Crying out, roar, humming, chirping &c.

s: klI, (ut + naha + GaY .) kAYjikam । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ uda + naha--GaY । 1 uttolyabanDane 2 kAYjike na॰ hemaca॰ ।
m: उन्-नाह m. excess, abundance, BhP. xi, 19, 43
impudence, haughtiness, BhP.
sour gruel (made from the fermentation of rice), L.
a: उन्नाहः — 1 Projection, protuberance; स्तन˚ Māl. 9; rise; बलाहक˚ K. 26. --2 Tying up. --हं Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice.

m: उन्-नाल (उद्-ना˚) mfn. having an upraised stalk, Bālar.; Kād.
a: उन्नाल — a. With the stalk prominently appearing; Māl. 9. 13.

m: उन्-नाम m. the act of bending one's self upwards, raising one's self, rising, Pañcat.
a: उन्नामः — Raising, lifting up; शतबुद्धिः कृतोन्नामः Pt. 5. 45 lifted up.

m: उन्-नामित mfn. = उन्-नमित above.
उन्-नाम्य ind.p. = उन्-नम्य above.

s: puM, (unnayanaM iti । ut + nI + GaY .) unnayanam । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA BawwiH । 7 । 37 । “unnAyAnaDigacCantaH pradrAvErvasuDABftAm” ॥)

m: उन्-नाय See below.
उन्-नाय m. the act of raising, elevating, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 26.

k.v: उन्नाय उन्नये श्रायः श्रयणे जयने जयः। निगादो निगदे मादो मद उद्वेग उद्भ्रमे॥

a: उन्नायक — a. 1 Raising, lifting up. --2 What leads to an inference or conclusion.

m: 1. उन्-√ नी (उद्-√ नी) P. Ā. -नयति, -ते, to lead up or out, lead upwards or up to; to bring or fetch out of, free from, help, rescue, redeem; to raise, set up, erect, promote, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.; to draw up, fill up a vessel by drawing (a fluid out of another vessel), RV. ii, 14, 9; VS.; TS.; ŚBr. &c.; to raise up, lift up (only Ā. Pāṇ. i, 3, 36); to put up, lay up, MBh.; to press or squeeze out (e.g. pus), MBh. v, 2776; to lead away (e.g. a calf from its mother), TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; KātyŚr.; to lead aside, separate, MBh.; BhP.; to stroke, smooth, Gṛhyās.; to raise, cause, BhP.; to intone, BhP. x, 33, 10; to find out, discover by inference, infer, MBh.; Rājat.; Daś.; Bālar. &c.: Desid. Ā. -निनीषते, to intend or wish to lead out, KauṣUp.
2. उन्-नी mfn. bringing or leading upwards, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 82.
a: उन्नी — {c1c} P. 1 To lead upwards, bring up. --2 To raise, erect, lift up (A.); दंडमुन्नयते Sk.; स्वदंष्ट्रोन्नीतधरो वराहः Bhāg. --3 To bring out of, free from, help, rescue, redeem; रसाया लीलयोन्नीतां उर्वीं Bhāg. --4 To draw up (as water). --5 To stroke; straighten out. --6 To lead out or aside, lead away; एकांतमुन्नीय Mb. --7 To press out, extract. --8 To infer, ascertain, guess, conjecture; कथमपि स इत्युन्नेतव्यस्तथापि दृशोः प्रियः U. 3. 22, 1. 29, 6. 26; V. 4; प्रकृतिप्रत्ययाद्यर्थैः संकीर्णे लिंगमुन्नयेत् Ak. --9 To fill completely. --10 To lead off (in singing).

m: उन्-नीपम् ind. uphill, VS., Sch.

v: tri॰ ud + nI--kta । 1 UrdDvaM nIte 2 vitarkite ca ।
m: उन्-नीत mfn. led up
drawn out (as Soma), RV. ix, 81, 1; TS.; ŚBr. &c.
led away or apart, separated, BhP.
उन्-नीत n. the act of drawing out
filling up, AitBr.
उन्-नीत—शिख mfn. having the locks of hair parted upwards (from the forehead), Suparṇ.
उन्-नीत—शुष्म (उन्नीत˚), mfn. one whose breath goes upwards, MaitrS. i, 1, 11.
उन्नीतिन् mfn. one who has drawn out or filled up, AitBr.
उन्-नीय mfn. to be led upwards, Ved. by, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 123.
उन्-नीयम् ind.p. pouring or sprinkling upwards, ŚāṅkhGṛ. iv, 14, 4.

s: tri, (unda + kta । nudavideti pakze natvam .) klinnaH । dayAparaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: tri॰ unda--kta । klinne 1 Ardre (Bije) 2 dayApare ca । pakze utta Arwwe tri॰ ।
m: उन्न mfn. wetted, wet, moistened, moist, KātyŚr. &c.
kind, humane, L.
उन्न See 2. उद्.
a: उन्न — p. p. 1 Wet, wetted, moist. --2 (fig.) Kind, moved to pity.

m: उन्-नभ् (उद्-√ नभ्), Caus. (Impv. 2. sg. -नम्भय) to tear open, open, TS.
उन्-√ नश् (उद्- √ 1. नश्) P. (Subj. -नशत्) to reach, obtain, RV. i, 164, 22; ii, 23, 8.
उन्-√ नद् (उद्-√ नद्) P. -नदति, to cry out, roar, make a noise, MBh.; R.; BhP.; Kum.; Pañcat.
a: उन्नद् — {c1c} P. To roar or below aloud, sound, roar (in general); असोढसिंहध्वनिरुन्ननाद Ku. 1. 56; कालमेघ इवोन्नदन् Mb.

v: tri॰ ud + naha--kta । 1 udbadDe । utkawe ca । “jahyastrateja unnadDamastrajYo'syastratejasA” BA॰ 1 ska॰ । unnadDaM utkawam” । SrIDaraH ।
m: उन्-नद्ध mfn. tied or bound up, Ragh.
swollen, increased, BhP.; Gīt.
unbound, excessive, BhP.
arrogant, impudent, haughty, self-conceited, MBh.; BhP.; Rājat.
a: उन्नद्ध — p. p. 1 Tied or bound up, fastened; तेऽस्य मुक्तागुणोन्नद्धं मौलिमंतर्गतस्रजं R. 17. 23; 18. 50; Ku. 3. 46. --2 Swelled, increased, heaving; श्वासोन्नद्धपयोधर Gīt. 12. --3 Unbound. --4 Elated, flushed with; वीर्य˚, मद˚, बल˚ &c.

m: उन्-√ नह् (उद्-√ नह्) P. -नह्यति, to tie up, bind up; to free from fetters or ties, push out, Suśr.; Kauś.; to free one's self from fetters, rush out, get out, MBh.
a: उन्नह् — {c4c} P. 1 To tie up, bind up, fasten round. --2 To draw out, pull out. --3 To come out of, rise from.

m: उन्-नहन (fr. नहन with उद् in the sense of ‘apart’), freed from fetters, unfettered, unbound, BhP. xi, 1, 4.

उन्-√ नम् (उद्-√ नम्) P. -नमति, to bend upwards, raise one's self, rise, ascend, Prab.; Mṛcch.; Pañcat.; Bhartṛ. &c.; to raise up, lift up, Pañcat. : Caus. -नमयति, or -नामयति, to bend upwards, raise, erect, elevate, MBh.; R.; Śak.; Kathās. &c.
a: उन्नम् — {c1c} P. 1 (a) To rise, appear; उन्नम्योन्नम्य लीयंते दरिद्राणां मनोरथाः Pt. 2. 91. (b) To hang over, arise, impend; उन्नमत्यकालदुर्दिनम् Mk. 4, 5 an untimely storm impends; बहलोन्नमदंबुधराः Māl. 9. 18. (c) To rise, ascend, go up (fig. also); उन्नमति नमति वर्षति गर्जति मेघः Mk. 5; नम्रत्वेनोन्नमंतः Bh. 2. 69. --2 To bend up, raise, elevate, erect; Ki. 16. 35. --Caus. (नमयति) 1 To bend upwards, raise, erect; मुखमुन्नमय्य Ku. 7. 23; Ś. 3. 25; R. 1. 41. --2 (fig.) To elevate, raise to eminence; उन्नमय बंधुवर्गं K. 109.

m: उन्-नमन n. the act of bending upwards
raising, lifting up, Suśr.
increase, prosperity, Prasannar.
a: उन्नमनं — 1 Raising, lifting up. --2 Height, elevation.

m: उन्-नमय्य ind.p. having raised, Kum.

m: उन्-नमित mfn. caused to rise, raised, elevated, lifted or pulled up
heightened, increased, Suśr.; Ragh.; Śak.; Hit. &c.
a: उन्नमित — p. p. 1 Raised, lifted up. --2 Heightened, increased, proved to be superior; ˚उपदेशः M. 3.

m: उन्-नम्र mfn. ascending, rising
erect, upright, elevated, lofty, high.
a: उन्नम्र — a. Erect, upright, lofty, high (fig. also); उन्नम्रताम्रपटमंडपमंडितं तत् Śi. 5. 68; ˚ता erectness, uprightness (of the body).

m: उन्-नम्र—ता f. ascension, ascent, rising, Rājat.
उन्-नम्य ind.p. having raised, raising, elevating
causing to increase &c., Yājñ.; Kathās.; BhP.; VarBṛS. &c.

m: उन्-नस mfn. having a prominent nose, BhP., Kāś.
a: उन्नस — a. [उन्नता नासिका यस्य] Having a prominent nose; उन्नसं दधती वक्त्रं Bk. 4. 18.

m: उन्नतानत mfn. elevated and depressed, uneven
undulating, wavy, L.

m: उन्नतीश m. ‘the lord of Unnati’, N. of Garuḍa.

। si॰ Si॰ ukte dinamAnajYAnasADane 3 upAyaBede na॰ । “uktA praBABimatadiNgiyamena tAvat tAmeva kAlaniyamena ca vacima BUyaH । myAdunnataM dyugataSezakayoryadalpaM tenonita dinadalaM natasaMjYakaM ca । aTonnatAdUnayutAccareRa kramAdudagdakziRagolayorjyA । syAt sUtrametadguRitaM dyumOrvyA vyAsArDaBaktaM ca kalABiDAnam” Si॰ । “divasasya yadgataM yacca SezaM tayoryadalpa tadunnatasaMjYaM jYeyam । tenonnatenonIkftaM dinadalapramARaM tannatasaMjYaM Bavati । aTonnatAdunnatakAlAduttaragoKe ca tenOnitA dakziRe yutAdyA jyA tatsUtram । sA sUtrasaMjYetyarTaH । tat sUtraM dyujyayA guRitaM trijyayA BaktaM kalAsaMjYaM Bavati । atropapattiH । yasmin kAle CAyA sADyA tasmin kAle svAhorAtravftte yAvatIBirGawikABiH kzitijAdunnato ravistAsAmunnatasaMjYA । yeka kAlena maDyAhnAnnatastasya natasaMjYA । aTa careRonayutasyoSratakAlasya kila jyA sADyA । sA ca jyA maDyAvaDirBavati । sa ca maDyapradeSo'horAtravfttasvonmaRqalasaMpAte Bavati । yata unmaRqalasaMpAtAByAmUrDvamahorAtravfttasyArDamaDo'rDam । jyA sADitA sA trijyAvfttapariRatA । sA ca sUtrasaMjYA । aTa yadi trijyAvftta etAvatI tadA dyujyAvftte kiyatItyanupAtena dyujyAvfttapariRatA । sA ca kalAsaMjYA” prami॰ । si॰ Si॰ uktegrahARAmakzalambajYAnArTe 4 upAyaBede ca । “yantraveDaviDinA DruvonnatiryA natiSca Bavato'kzalambakO । tO kramAdvizuvadahnyahardaleye'Ta vA natasamunnatA lavAH” Si॰ “cakrayantreRa grahaveDavad DruvaM viDyet । tatra yantranemyAM ya unnatAMSAste'kzAMSAH । ye natAste lambAMSAH । aTa vA vizuvaddinArdDe ye'rkasya natonnatAMSAste'kzalambAMSA iti yuktiyuktam” prami॰ । “unnataM dyuniSamaRqale kujAt
